data.exact_reserve_text: Included within claims notified of USD 1,398.0m (2021: USD 1,400.1m) is a decrease in claims notified relating to 2021 and prior years of account of USD 229.9m (2021: increase in claims notified relating to 2020 and prior years of account USD 397.3m which is impacted by effect of RITC noted in the table above).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate has been indemnified against potential adverse development in respect of net liabilities for a premium of USD 59.7m, providing the Syndicate with protection in several professional lines insurance portfolios, predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account. The income statement includes USD 59.7m of reinsurance premium for the LPR and USD 59.7m of reinsurance recoveries in net claims. Reinsurer's share of claims outstanding includes USD 52.8m in respect of the loss portfolio reinsurance agreement.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross claims notified release of USD 229.9 million for the 2021 and prior years of account, representing a 10.6% favorable development against opening gross claims outstanding. This release is part of a broader movement in claims notified, which for 2021 also included an increase of USD 397.3 million for 2020 and prior years, impacted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC). The Syndicate also entered into a Loss Portfolio Reinsurance (LPR) agreement in 2022, providing protection for professional lines insurance portfolios predominantly relating to 2019 and prior years of account, with USD 59.7 million in reinsurance recoveries. General reserving risks include unforeseen loss trends from court rulings, changes in law, differences in loss adjustment practice, medical and long-term care, and economic factors such as inflation.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the impact of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) and Loss Portfolio Reinsurance (LPR) transactions, making it unreliable for direct calculation of prior year development. The prior year development figure is taken from an explicit statement in Note 4.
